assessment_versions_publication_state_ch.name: assessment_versions_publication_state_check
assessment_versions_publication_state_ch.value:
("assessment_versions"."status" <> 'published' OR "assessment_versions"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("assessment_versions"."published_at" IS NULL OR "assessment_versions"."status" IN ('published', 'archived'))
